properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Correction to earlier context: ed25519-dalek@1.0.1 in the root Cargo.lock is pulled by agave-precompiles 4.2.2 (on-chain Ed25519 + libsecp256k1 signature verification in the validator used by the test stack), not by the wallet. The wallet's Solana keypairs use ed25519-dalek 2.2.0 via solana-keypair 3.1.2 (which also wires ed25519-dalek-bip32, solana-seed-phrase and rand 0.9.5). TWO Ed25519 implementations ship with the build; both quantum-unsafe, migrate on a schedule to ML-DSA-65.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency declaration: curve25519-dalek@3.2.0 in Cargo.lock. In this dependency graph it is the Curve25519 arithmetic layer beneath ed25519-dalek@1.0.1 (Solana Ed25519 keypairs) — a signature context, not an X25519 key agreement; no ECDH/x25519 call site exists in the workspace. Shipped library, observable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency declaration: ring@0.17.14 in Cargo.lock provides X25519 among its primitives. In this workspace ring is a transitive dependency (rustls/QUIC-related stack), with no direct X25519 key-agreement call site in first-party code; the library and its primitives ship with the build. Observable here.
